svg.metadata: {"logicalPartId": "puff_sleeve_image_left", "step": "clothing-raster-layering/step01", "sourceSvgAtGenerationSha256": "2e5e9f9b3e401c04ded7167c6225fc033b955de64b3181790749b7ceec6570a9", "actualAlphaSha256": "23e302dba0d5fe05e25cfb8d54a7aaec8f7e162fef9ef8f1a9db5fbe3860004e", "motionIdentity": "puff_sleeve_image_left", "ordinaryPaintLayers": [{"name": "0017 puff_sleeve_image_left :: depth_17", "level": 17}, {"name": "0029 puff_sleeve_image_left :: depth_29", "level": 29}], "regions": [{"level": 17, "layer": "0017 puff_sleeve_image_left :: depth_17", "region": "袖筒内侧被衣身盖住的后绕窄接合；沿袖出口内侧回转接前鼓袖29，不补人体或封底。；下袖口后侧暗窄弧，沿出口两端回转接29的前波浪边；后弧在前弧之后，实际开口透明。", "span_file": "parts/puff_sleeve_image_left/depth-17-spans.json"}, {"level": 29, "layer": "0029 puff_sleeve_image_left :: depth_29", "region": "左袖外鼓花瓣主袖面及下方紫灰袖口前缘，约 x270–389/y333–464 的可见前向区域；沿出口两侧回转带连续接 level 17，前弧压住后绕袖弧，内侧接触处仍在 halter_bodice 前衣面之后；花纹随本袖。", "span_file": "parts/puff_sleeve_image_left/depth-29-spans.json"}], "reason": "固定坐标下可见轮廓与实际KRA同步；保留生成的被遮接合；共同运动多深度以互补绘画片表达", "visibleHemCorrection": "按真实自由边和卷回反面归属恢复本片可见参考材质；被遮补全保留生成与Krita画笔。"}
